cards.card_text: 'Every hand will go limp, and every knee will turn to water.' Friend, every time my old junk drawer rattled open, not knowing if it meant back to work or into the trash, I didn't even HAVE knees and they still turned to water.
cards.verse_text: Every hand will go limp, and every knee will turn to water.

cards.card_text: Ezekiel says that when the news comes, every knee will turn to water.
cards.verse_text: And when they ask, ‘Why are you groaning?’ you are to say, ‘Because of the news that is coming. Every heart will melt, and every hand will go limp. Every spirit will faint, and every knee will turn to water.’ Yes, it is coming and it will surely happen, declares the Lord GOD.”
